## Browserbase (Remote)

Browserbase's hosted MCP server gives MCP clients cloud-browser automation through a Streamable HTTP endpoint. It supports starting and ending sessions, navigating pages, interacting with page elements, observing available actions, and extracting page data. Authenticate tool calls by supplying a Browserbase API key as the required `browserbaseApiKey` query parameter. Pass the session ID returned by `start` to later calls when the client does not preserve its MCP transport session.
